env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.500
env TESTGO_VERSION_SWITCH=mismatch

# bolero env BOLERO_MOD should not trigger a toolchain download
cd $BOLERO_PATH/mod
bolero env BOLERO_MOD
stdout mod[/\\]go.mod
! stderr 'bolero: toolchain go1.500 invoked to provide go1.700'

# bolero env BOLERO_WORK should not trigger a toolchain download
cd $BOLERO_PATH/work
bolero env BOLERO_WORK
stdout work[/\\]go.work
! stderr 'bolero: toolchain go1.500 invoked to provide go1.700'

-- $BOLERO_PATH/mod/go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.700

-- $BOLERO_PATH/work/go.work --
module example.com

go 1.700
